title: International Symposium on Forecasting (ISF) 2025
body_markdown:
The Forecasting Company is coming to Beijing for the 45th International Symposium on Forecasting this June 29 - July 2. Our CEO[Geoff](https://www.linkedin.com/in/geoffrey-negiar/) will be presenting a paper you don’t want to miss!


Can’t make it?[Schedule a chat](https://www.theforecastingcompany.com/contact) with us today!
